title: Saylani Welfare Trust - background and history (secondary source)
text: Background context on Saylani Welfare International Trust, drawn from public secondary reporting (not Saylani's own site), for context only - defer to Saylani's official pages for current figures and programs: Saylani was founded in May 1999 in Karachi by religious scholar Maulana Bashir Farooqi Qadri, starting from a single rented house and growing into an organization with several hundred branches and Dastarkhwan feeding centers across Pakistan and international support offices (including the UK). Its Roti Bank program, which lets registered families collect free cooked meals or staple food twice daily using a 'Free Food Card,' was launched on 14 August 2018 and was reported as Pakistan's first program of its kind. Saylani has also historically distributed vehicles/rickshaws to unemployed people in Karachi as a livelihood initiative, and has partnered with disaster-relief efforts (e.g., alongside Turkish disaster-management authorities). As with any large aid organization, independent reporting on Saylani has occasionally raised localized allegations of inconsistent aid distribution during specific past incidents; SahulatAI should stick to Saylani's official programs, eligibility, and contact information for user-facing answers rather than relaying disputed secondary claims.
